versions.changelog:
- Initial release: Automated Japanese video translation and hard-subtitle workflow.
- Supports full pipeline: ffmpeg audio extraction, Whisper transcription, LLM-based Japanese-to-Chinese translation, SRT-to-ASS conversion, ffmpeg NVENC hard-subtitle rendering, and validation.
- Resilient to interruptions: Implements step-wise checkpointing and file existence checks for resumability.
- Automatic fallback mechanisms: GPU/CPU encoding switch, LLM/MyMemory translation backup.
- Includes detailed troubleshooting guide and performance benchmarks.
